notes.title: Warp Out: Mid February Update
notes.notes:
The middle of February marks our first update for the game, we hope you'll like it!

[h3]In-game score indicator[/h3]
The enemies will now show how much score you've gained by destroying them in game.
As a reminder, the score depends on the enemy type, and the time you take to destroy it!

[h3]Better score visibility[/h3]
The Grip button to show the score was not very clear, and not very convenient.
We switched it to a toggle button, so you don't have to keep it pressed to view your score.
We also added a quick segment to the tutorial to show how to use it.

[h3]New achievements[/h3]
There is now an achievement to finish the game in each difficulty.
If you've already finished the game, you'll just have to finish any level to unlock it.
And of course, if you finish the game in any difficulty, you'll unlock the achievements for the easier difficulties as well!

[h3]Spanish translation[/h3]
The text of the game is now fully translated in Spanish. That includes the instructions, the subtitles, the achievements, etc!

[h3]New sounds & musics[/h3]
There are now 3 musics per world, and almost every enemy has a custom sound effects. We'll keep working on environmental sounds, and more effects for the bosses!

[h3]Fixed Oculus bug[/h3]
If you tried to launch the game on an Oculus headset with SteamVR, the Pause button was not usable, and the ship was not properly attached to the controller. Sorry about this issue, it has been fixed! As always, do not hesitate to contact us if you have this kind of issues

[h2]Coming up[/h2]
The boss of Cerberus is almost finished, and should come out very soon!
We're also working on a German translation.
The hardcore difficulty curently reworked, to add more depth to it.
The endless is not yet as fun as we would like, so for now it stays in the pipeline.

notes.title: Warp Out is now available!
notes.notes:
We're very proud to release Warp Out, our first VR Shoot'em up!

It's been a challenging journey that started almost a year ago, and we're very excited to see what you'll think of the game!

[h2]The Release[/h2]
The release includes the main campaign, with four planets:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39593469/b6f05222a3bf7b352bc80b3312442e59062b9443.png[/img]
[b]Karpos[/b], [b]Cerberus[/b], [b]Permafrost[/b] and [b]Adamantis[/b]
Each planets contains 5 levels, unique enemies and environment, for a total of 35km of levels!

You'll also find a Boss at the end of Karpos and Adamantis!
We hope that you'll like this campaign, and we'll see you on the leaderboards!

[h2]The future[/h2]
Of course, the release of the game doesn't mean it's the end of our journey, it's only the beginning!
Here are the updates planned for February:
[list]
[*] Spanish translation of the interface & subtitles
[*] Cerberus's Boss
[*] The discord server, with bots to follow the leaderboards of the game
[*] German translation of the interface & subtitles
[*] More musics and sounds for the game
[*] The endless mode
[/list]

We'll keep you posted frequently on the incoming updates
Let us know if you have any issues with Warp Out, and most importantly,

Have fun!
